sourceChecks.quote: 入隋，依例授儀同三司。頃之卒。
sourceChecks.translation: After entering Sui service he was granted, by precedent, the rank of general-in-chief with the ceremonial equipage of a three-division commandery. Before long he died.
sourceChecks.result: The sequence makes death subsequent to the 589 Sui entry but does not name its year. An on-or-after AD 589 bound is supported; a point death in AD 589 is not.
